title: A little journey, before your first sip.
label: ORIGIN STORY · COLOMBIA
footnote: Illustrated Colombia stop, not a verified origin of your cup.
text: Jayasri, three orders ahead. Follow the coffee guide to an illustrated Colombian coffee hillside.

title: Picked with a little patience.
label: THE HARVEST
footnote: Illustrated harvest · This happened before your order.
text: Ripe coffee cherries leave the branch, one by one. Inside each fruit are the seeds we call coffee beans.

title: From cherry to something rich.
label: FROM HARVEST TO ROAST
footnote: Illustrated roasting · Your café’s verified sourcing story goes here.
text: The seeds are processed, dried, then roasted before reaching the café. One order ahead. Your turn is close.

title: They’re making your latte now.
label: NOW PREPARING · BREWING ESPRESSO
text: Your turn, Jayasri. The beans are ground, and two shots of espresso flow into your cup. Your latte begins.

title: A soft swirl of milk.
label: NOW PREPARING · POURING MILK
footnote: Cold 2% milk. No steamed milk, mocha sauce, or whipped cream.
text: Cold 2% milk meets the espresso. Ivory ribbons curl into caramel-colored swirls. Your iced latte is taking shape.

title: A little chill. A final swirl.
label: NOW PREPARING · ADDING ICE
footnote: Coffee, milk, and ice. The standard recipe, simply illustrated.
text: In goes the ice. A gentle swirl, a little chill. Your latte is nearly ready.

title: The finishing touch, just for you.
label: NOW PREPARING · FINISHING YOUR CUP
footnote: Adding the lid and setting your cup on the pickup counter.
text: The lid settles into place. Your name goes on the cup. One final touch, made for Jayasri.

title: Voilà, Jayasri. Your order is ready.
label: READY FOR PICKUP
text: Voilà, Jayasri. Your iced latte is ready to pick up. Your finished cup and its nutrition are right here.
